clips.title: The story
paras: Iron Rivet shipments from Stormwind now lie in gnoll camps north of Lake Everstill. Foreman Oslow needs them to mend Lakeshire's damaged bridge.

Lakeshire's iron stores went into weapons and armor when Blackrock orcs attacked. After the assaults eased, Foreman Oslow asked Stormwind for supplies to mend the damaged Everstill Bridge. Redridge gnolls ambushed the caravan before it reached town. They dragged its wagons and pack beasts into the hills north of Lake Everstill, scattering iron rivets and pikes among their camps.

The Everstill Bridge needs heavy iron rivets to hold its stone and timber framework together under the weight of carts and travelers. Foreman Oslow cannot safely carry out repairs without them. The bridge links Lakeshire to the western valleys, and its repair will help secure the town's perimeter against further incursions.
